niche_preference_profile: Prefers bright, light, airy interfaces with restrained visual weight, clear grouped hierarchy, and polished minimal styling. They consistently like spacious layouts, subtle or native-feeling controls, softer rounded surfaces, and content that is easy to scan through structured sections or list rows. They generally reject dark, heavy, high-contrast, overly carded, cluttered, or fragmented layouts. They also favor task-focused screens where key information and actions are clearly emphasized without decorative excess.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers light, bright, airy canvases and soft backgrounds over dark, near-black, or visually heavy backgrounds.
Prefers information grouped into clear labeled sections with strong top-down hierarchy and easy scanability, rather than scattered or weakly structured layouts.
Prefers fewer competing elements, simplified compositions, and cleaner screens that remove unnecessary sections or distractions.
Prefers generous whitespace, airier spacing, and clearer separation between sections rather than tightly packed layouts.
Prefers restrained, polished UI components such as subtle toggles, outlined inputs, lighter cards, softer borders, and gentler rounded surfaces instead of chunky or attention-grabbing controls.
Prefers high-contrast, easy-to-read text and metadata with cleaner spacing and calmer color use, avoiding dim text or backgrounds that interfere with readability.
Prefers actions that are clearly separated, placed near relevant content, and presented in a stable, obvious layout rather than buried, detached, or competing with surrounding content.
